key.name: position
key.description: Specifies the position of this eye on the panel: 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

key.name: index
key.summary: Index of this eye in its panel section
key.description: Specifies the order priority of this eye within its panel section (-1 places it at the rightmost).

key.name: width
key.description: Specifies the width in pixels of this eye's button, affecting drawing space and padding.

key.name: shape
key.description: Specifies the shape of this eye: 'natural', 'round', or 'comic'.

key.name: outline-mode
key.summary: Outline drawing state of this eye
key.description: Indicates whether this eye is drawn as an outline or filled.

key.name: line-width
key.summary: Line width of this eye's drawing
key.description: Specifies the thickness of the lines used to draw this eye.

key.name: color-iris-enabled
key.description: Indicates whether this eye's iris uses a custom color instead of the foreground color.

key.name: color-iris
key.description: Specifies the color of this eye's iris.

key.name: color-pupil
key.description: Specifies the color of this eye's pupil.

key.name: color-eyelid
key.description: Specifies the color of this eye's eyelid.
